plan.summary: Merge the two separate nav pages (Veri İçe Aktarma / Veri Dışa Aktarma) into one 'Veri Yönetimi' page (/data-management/:tab) with two tabs: 'Veri İçe Aktarma (Listeler)' -> DataImportPage and 'Veri Dışa Aktarma (Export)' -> ExportManagerPage. Frontend/SPA only; no backend, DB, or API change.
plan.q_intent: Data yönetimi sayfasında iki sekmeye yerleştir. veri içe aktarma (Listeler) ve veri dışa aktarma (Export).
plan.interview_notes: Path-based tab (/data-management/:tab) chosen over a query param so it is deep-linkable, survives refresh, and never collides with the inner pages' own state. Each tab page stays lazy and only the active one mounts (heavy DataImport/Export bundles never both load). Old /data-import and /data-export routes redirect to the new tabs for back-compat; the two nav items collapse into one 'Veri Yönetimi'.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A single 'Veri Yönetimi' nav item opens /data-management with two tabs; 'Veri İçe Aktarma (Listeler)' renders DataImportPage and 'Veri Dışa Aktarma (Export)' renders ExportManagerPage; the active tab is path-based and survives refresh.

Only the active tab's page is mounted (each lazy-loaded); switching tabs loads just that bundle. Old /data-import and /data-export URLs redirect to /data-management/import and /data-management/export. SPA build (tsc+vite) PASSES with no unused-import errors.

files_changed.change: new two-tab container; path-based tab; lazy-mounts active inner page
lazy DataManagementPage; /data-management/:tab route + redirect /data-import,/data-export; dropped direct DataImport/Export route imports
two nav items collapsed into one 'Veri Yönetimi'; removed now-unused Download icon import

verification_questions.question: Do the old /data-import and /data-export routes still resolve (Navigate redirect to /data-management/import and /data-management/export) so existing bookmarks/links do not 404 after the merge?
Is only the ACTIVE tab's page mounted (DataImportPage and ExportManagerPage each lazy, conditional render), so switching tabs does not keep both heavy pages mounted nor eagerly load both bundles?

Does the path-based tab behave correctly: refreshing on /data-management/export stays on the Export tab, an unknown :tab value falls back to the import tab without crashing, and the single 'Veri Yönetimi' nav item highlights as active on /data-management?

Does /data-management/:tab (and the /data-import,/data-export redirects) remain behind the same ProtectedRoute auth gate as every other dashboard route, introducing no unauthenticated exposure of the import/export surfaces?

Does the merge leave the inner pages' tenant-scoped data fetching unchanged — DataImportPage's list APIs and ExportManagerPage's filter/count/history/create-list calls are untouched, with only the parent route/tab wrapper added (no data request logic altered)?

build.command: cd src/Invekto.Backend/Dashboard && npm run build (tsc && vite build)

forbidden_areas: DataImportPage.tsx / ExportManagerPage.tsx internals (unchanged; only re-parented under tabs)
Any backend/Outbound/DB/API code (frontend route reorganization only)
non_goals: Merging the two pages' content into one scroll view (they remain distinct tab panes)
intentional_exclusions: Removing the inner pages' own H1 titles (kept; redundant with tab label but harmless)

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Pure routing/UI composition. An unknown :tab value falls back to the 'import' tab (no crash). Lazy-load failures surface via the Suspense fallback spinner. No data paths changed.

aha_moments.user_pain: Import and Export were two separate sidebar items for what is one mental task (managing contact data).
aha_moments.suggestion: Collapse them into one 'Veri Yönetimi' page with İçe/Dışa tabs.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator finds both data tasks in one place and flips between them without hunting the sidebar.

aha_moments.user_pain: Loading both heavy bundles when you only need one is wasteful.
aha_moments.suggestion: Lazy-mount only the active tab's page.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Opening the page loads just the import bundle; the export bundle loads only when its tab is clicked.

aha_moments.user_pain: Existing bookmarks/links to /data-import or /data-export would break after the merge.
aha_moments.suggestion: Redirect the old routes to the matching tab.
aha_moments.aha_moment: An old /data-export bookmark still lands the operator on the Export tab.

aha_moments.user_pain: A tab choice lost on refresh forces re-navigation.
aha_moments.suggestion: Path-based tab (/data-management/:tab) so refresh/deep-link preserves the tab.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator refreshes on the Export tab and stays on Export.

aha_moments.user_pain: Support guiding a user to 'the export screen' had to explain a separate menu item.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Support says 'Veri Yönetimi > Dışa Aktarma tab' and the user is there in one step.

verdict.notes: Code was clean from iter0 (all CQ1-12 PASS, all CoVe PASS). iter0 FAIL: routing change must be MEDIUM not LOW. iter1 FAIL: MEDIUM needs verification-question coverage across Data+Auth categories. iter2 PASS: reclassified MEDIUM + added Auth (Q4) and Data (Q5) questions. No code changed across iterations — policy-only.
